transcript: Life does not change until you're ready for it to change. The more that I think about understanding openness and intention, the more clarity that I get that I take responsibility for the life that I live. When I don't like something or when I feel like I'm being misguided, that is when I take action. I don't wait to take action because the longer that you wait, the harder it is to make changes, the harder it is to think logically and think clearly. Because at that point, you get into survival mode. You have to trust yourself that you have everything that you need to change your world.
